info.name: Azhar Residence - Admin API
info.description:
Azhar Residence Admin API collection. Import directly into Postman or APIDog. Login stores accessToken/refreshToken automatically.

Audited and synchronized with the Azhar production API on 2026-08-15. No hard-coded production credentials are included.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', j.accessToken); if (j.refreshToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', j.refreshToken); if (j.user && j.user.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', j.user.id); if (j.user && j.user.tenantId) pm.collectionVariables.set('tenantId', j.user.tenantId); if (j.user && j.user.staffId) pm.collectionVariables.set('staffId', j.user.staffId);
